Are you open to the public? Yes. If I’m a teacher, am I eligible for a discount on purchases? You can also check the status of an order by logging into your account on our website. Can I make changes to an order I have already placed? Only if an order hasn’t shipped yet. We have a 30-day return policy as long as the items are unopened and you have the original receipt. If you don’t have a receipt, but the item is unopened, you can either exchange it for the same or a different item (of equal value), or we can offer you store credit. REWARDS How does your CM School Supply Rewards program work? For every dollar you spend, you earn points, after you reach 200 points, you earn $20 towards your next or future purchase. Can I use my CM School Supply Rewards for purchases made online? Unfortunately no, the rewards points are honored only in-store. EMAILS How do I subscribe to receive CM School Supply’s e-mails?
